learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the incredible treasures of our planet, learn how to classify different types of resources, and become an earth-saving champion through sustainable development!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look around you! Anything that satisfies a human need has 'utility' (usability) and is called a resource. The water you drink, the electricity lighting your room, and even the textbook you study from are all valuable resources.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🌳 The Big Three: Types of Resources
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Resources fall into three cool categories: Natural (gifts from nature like rivers and forests), Human-made (things we build using nature, like bridges and smartphones), and Human (people's knowledge, skills, and health). Yes, you are a super valuable resource too!

Natural resources can be split into two teams. Renewable resources, like solar energy and wind, replenish quickly and will not run out. Non-renewable resources, like coal and petroleum, take millions of years to form. Once we use them up, they are gone forever!

Resource conservation means using things carefully and giving them time to renew. Sustainable development is the ultimate balancing act: using what we need today while protecting the planet so future generations can enjoy these resources too.

fun_activity.title: ⚡ The Home Resource Audit
fun_activity.instructions: Be an Earth Detective! Walk around your house and spot 3 resources you use daily (like water, electricity, or paper). Write down one simple action you will take starting today to save or reuse each of them.

quick_recap: ⭐ Utility is the magic word that turns an everyday object into a valuable resource.
⭐ Natural resources are divided into renewable (unlimited) and non-renewable (limited) groups.
⭐ Sustainable development is crucial to balance our modern needs with the health of our planet.
